items.context: Specialized in Mathematics and Computer Science. Introduction to network architecture concepts, algorithmic scripting, and mathematical logic applied to data processing.

Program combining software engineering fundamentals with the rigor of discrete mathematics. In-depth study of algorithms and structured programming in Python, system management through shell scripting, and binary data representations. Strong skills developed in technical writing, formal logic, database modeling, and computer science project design.

Program focused on offensive and defensive cybersecurity, network infrastructure, and secure development. Hands-on learning through a YTRACK peer-to-peer platform and active participation in national and inter-campus competitions (Capture The Flag, HackTheBox). Proficiency in Linux and Windows Server administration, containerization, cloud security, scripting and tool development in Python, PHP, or C#, as well as incident response.

items.label: Melvin THEODORE
items.text: With experience at ARKEMA and INTERPOL, Melvin supervised me across several specialised training programmes. He attests to my technical skills, my curiosity for the field, and my professional ethics, qualities he considers essential in cybersecurity careers.

items.label: Cellya SIROT
items.text: Cellya entrusted me with a key role on a nationally scoped digital project. She highlights my exemplary social skills in a business, my proactive contributions, some of which are still valued today, and my ability to grow autonomously when faced with complex technical challenges.

items.label: Alexandra IABONI
items.role: Head of Admissions - Lyon Ynov Campus
items.text: Alexandra worked alongside me during my time as a school ambassador and former member of the Student Sports Association. She vouches for my commitment to student life, my team spirit, and my ability to authentically represent the institution at major events.

items.label: Hiking
items.text: I love exploring natural areas and wandering mountain trails to recharge. Breathing fresh air away from daily life, pushing myself physically, and taking in wild landscapes: the mountains represent a space of freedom and reconnection with what truly matters.

items.label: Photography
items.text: Starting in 2021 with my father's Nikon Coolpix P510, photography quickly became a full-blown passion. I bring my camera everywhere: to school, on hikes, camping, on holiday. It is nearly always with me. Capturing a moment, choosing the light, freezing a landscape or a face: every shot is a new exploration.

items.label: Video Games
items.text: I have been playing video games since childhood, which helped me develop social and interpersonal skills long before my professional life. Wondering how a game was built led me to start coding, then to explore networking and systems, and finally to understanding how to protect them. Video games are at the root of my passion for cybersecurity.

items.label: Astronomy
items.text: A growing love for the sky, especially deep-sky observation. Galaxies, nebulae, star clusters: contemplating what is happening millions of light-years away gives me a unique perspective on the world. This passion naturally intersects with photography, particularly astrophotography, a field of exploration that never stops surprising me.

transition.label: versatility & background
transition.text: My background is not limited to technology alone. Through my diverse experiences, I have developed great adaptability by evolving in various fields: from managing high-pressure situations in the restaurant industry to the artistic sensitivity of photography and video, and the rigor of cybersecurity. Each domain has provided me with unique skills that enrich my professional vision.
